issues.concern: The explanation states 'The first day of the work week in Japan.' which is not universally true. While Monday is often the start of the work week, the 'first day of the week' can vary culturally (e.g., Sunday in some calendars). The explanation should focus on the meaning of the word itself rather than a cultural interpretation of the 'first day'.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'The first day of the work week in Japan.' or rephrase to 'Often considered the first day of the work week.'
